notes: Read all 113 source lines line by line before editing and preserved the TooltipPayload and ChartTooltipProps surfaces, including active, payload, label, valueFormatter, labelFormatter, unit, color/fill, and dataKey.

Ported the ISO timestamp heuristic, default label formatting, number formatting fallback, null inactive state, payload row mapping, name/value/unit rendering, and memoized ChartTooltip export to React Native-compatible TypeScript.

Converted the DOM div/p/span tooltip body into React Native View/AppText primitives with native tokens for elevated surface, border, rounded panel, shadow, label tone, marker dot, row spacing, and monospace value styling.

React Native has no direct role="tooltip" or aria-live DOM node; this port uses accessibilityRole="summary" with accessibilityLiveRegion="polite" to preserve the screen-reader intent without importing DOM, Recharts, Leaflet, or web UI components.
